CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [metrics].[CompareConditionValueToFieldValue] ( @dataType varchar(25), @operator varchar(5), @conditionValue nvarchar(250), @fieldValue nvarchar(max) ) RETURNS bit AS BEGIN declare @valid bit = 0, @false bit = 0, @true bit = 1, @defaultCheckText bit = 1
IF @fieldValue is null begin set @fieldValue = '' end
if @dataType = 'Boolean' begin declare @bCV bit = case lower(ltrim(rtrim(@conditionValue))) when 'true' then 1 when '1' then 1 when 'on' then 1 else 0 end, @bFV bit = case lower(ltrim(rtrim(@fieldValue))) when 'true' then 1 when '1' then 1 when 'on' then 1 else 0 end
select @valid = case when @operator = 'eq' and @bFV = @bCV then @true when @operator = 'neq' and @bFV <> @bCV then @true when @operator = 'lt' and @bFV < @bCV then @true when @operator = 'lte' and @bFV <= @bCV then @true when @operator = 'gt' and @bFV > @bCV then @true when @operator = 'gte' and @bFV >= @bCV then @true else @false end
set @defaultCheckText = 0 end if @dataType = 'Date' or @dataType = 'DateTime' begin if isdate(@conditionValue) = 1 and isdate(@fieldValue) = 1 begin declare @dtCV datetime = cast(@conditionValue as datetime), @dtFV datetime = cast(@fieldValue as datetime)
select @valid = case when @operator = 'eq' and @dtFV = @dtCV then @true when @operator = 'neq' and @dtFV <> @dtCV then @true when @operator = 'lt' and @dtFV < @dtCV then @true when @operator = 'lte' and @dtFV <= @dtCV then @true when @operator = 'gt' and @dtFV > @dtCV then @true when @operator = 'gte' and @dtFV >= @dtCV then @true else @false end
set @defaultCheckText = 0 end end if @dataType = 'Decimal' begin if REPLACE(ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(@conditionValue,'+','A') + 'e0'),1,CHARINDEX('.',@conditionValue)) = 1 and REPLACE(ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(@fieldValue,'+','A') + 'e0'),1,CHARINDEX('.',@fieldValue)) = 1 begin declare @dCV decimal = cast(@conditionValue as decimal), @dFV decimal = cast(@fieldValue as decimal)
select @valid = case when @operator = 'eq' and @dFV = @dCV then @true when @operator = 'neq' and @dFV <> @dCV then @true when @operator = 'lt' and @dFV < @dCV then @true when @operator = 'lte' and @dFV <= @dCV then @true when @operator = 'gt' and @dFV > @dCV then @true when @operator = 'gte' and @dFV >= @dCV then @true else @false end
set @defaultCheckText = 0 end end if @dataType = 'Number' begin if ISNUMERIC(Replace(Replace(@conditionValue,'+','A'),'-','A') + '.0e0') = 1 and ISNUMERIC(Replace(Replace(@fieldValue,'+','A'),'-','A') + '.0e0') = 1 begin declare @nCV int = cast(@conditionValue as int), @nFV int = cast(@fieldValue as int)
select @valid = case when @operator = 'eq' and @nFV = @nCV then @true when @operator = 'neq' and @nFV <> @nCV then @true when @operator = 'lt' and @nFV < @nCV then @true when @operator = 'lte' and @nFV <= @nCV then @true when @operator = 'gt' and @nFV > @nCV then @true when @operator = 'gte' and @nFV >= @nCV then @true else @false end
set @defaultCheckText = 0 end end
if @defaultCheckText = 1 begin select @valid = case when @operator = 'eq' and lower(@fieldValue) = lower(@conditionValue) then @true when @operator = 'neq' and lower(@fieldValue) <> lower(@conditionValue) then @true when @operator = 'lt' and lower(@fieldValue) < lower(@conditionValue) then @true when @operator = 'lte' and lower(@fieldValue) <= lower(@conditionValue) then @true when @operator = 'gt' and lower(@fieldValue) > lower(@conditionValue) then @true when @operator = 'gte' and lower(@fieldValue) >= lower(@conditionValue) then @true else @false end end
return @valid END

ALTER FUNCTION [metrics].[AssetMeetsConditions] ( @metricUid uniqueidentifier, @effectiveDate date, @assetUid uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS bit AS BEGIN declare @valid bit = 0
declare @conditions table (FieldTypeID int, Operator varchar(10), ValueJson nvarchar(max)) insert into @conditions select FieldTypeID, Operator, ValueJson from [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] where [Uid] = @metricUid and EffectiveDate = @effectiveDate
if exists (select 1 from @conditions) begin declare @stats table (Val bit) insert into @stats select metrics.CompareConditionValueToFieldValue(FT.[Type], C.Operator, C.ValueJson, F.Value) from Field F inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID inner join @conditions C on C.FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID inner join dbo.Asset A on A.ID = F.AssetID and A.[Uid] = @assetUid if exists(select 1 from @stats where Val = 0) begin set @valid = 0 end else begin set @valid = 1 end end else begin set @valid = 1 end
return @valid END
changeSet.rollback:
ALTER FUNCTION [metrics].[AssetMeetsConditions] ( @metricUid uniqueidentifier, @effectiveDate date, @assetUid uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS bit AS BEGIN declare @valid bit = 0
declare @conditions table (FieldTypeID int, Operator varchar(10), ValueJson nvarchar(max)) insert into @conditions select FieldTypeID, Operator, ValueJson from [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] where [Uid] = @metricUid and EffectiveDate = @effectiveDate
if exists (select 1 from @conditions) begin declare @stats table (Val bit) insert into @stats select case when C.Operator = 'eq' then case when C.ValueJson = F.Value then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end when C.Operator = 'neq' then case when C.ValueJson <> F.Value then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end when C.Operator = 'lt' then case when C.ValueJson < F.Value then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end when C.Operator = 'lte' then case when C.ValueJson <= F.Value then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end when C.Operator = 'gt' then case when C.ValueJson > F.Value then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end when C.Operator = 'gte' then case when C.ValueJson >= F.Value then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end else cast(1 as bit) end as Valid from Field F inner join @conditions C on C.FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID inner join dbo.Asset A on A.ID = F.AssetID and A.[Uid] = @assetUid if exists(select 1 from @stats where Val = 0) begin set @valid = 0 end else begin set @valid = 1 end end else begin set @valid = 1 end
return @valid END
